title: Boom Training now trades as Turing College in the UK
summary: Boom Training now trades as Turing College in the UK. Learn why the name changed and what stays the same for learners and employers.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


- From 30 October 2026, Boom Training trades as Turing College in the UK.
- Boom Training Ltd remains the legal apprenticeship provider, with the same UK team and regulatory responsibilities.
- Turing College UAB acquired Boom Training Ltd in March 2025; the UK business now uses the same name as the rest of the group.


From 30 October 2026, Boom Training trades as Turing College in the UK. Boom Training Ltd remains the legal apprenticeship provider. Learners and employers now see the Turing College name and logo on our website, emails and learning platform.


Turing College UAB acquired Boom Training Ltd in March 2025. The UK business now uses the same name as the rest of the group.


## Why the UK business now uses the Turing College name


Over the past year, our UK apprenticeships have moved from traditional standards to data and AI standards. That's the area Turing College is known for. Using one name across every market also tells employers what quality of service to expect.


In 2026, the Department for Work and Pensions selected Boom Training to pilot AI leadership apprenticeships. Over the last 12 months, we've also started apprenticeships with enterprise clients including VCCP, ASR and Nasdaq.


> “Boom Training has successfully scaled apprenticeships in the last 12 months within digital standards and adapted an innovative delivery model throughout digital standards. This is exactly where the Turing College brand is well known. Turing College is already established as one of the best AI and data providers in Germany & Lithuania.”
>
>
> Benas Šidlauskas, co-founder of Turing College


Our old website, boom-training.com, now redirects to[turingcollege.com/uk](https://www.turingcollege.com/uk) , and our UK social media accounts use the Turing College name. We emailed current learners and employers about the change on 30 October.


## What stays the same


Only the trading name has changed. Boom Training Ltd is still the registered apprenticeship provider, with the same responsibilities and regulatory obligations.


- The same UK team supports learners and employers.
- Boom Training Ltd continues to process UK learner data, so our privacy policy is unchanged.
- Contracts, invoices and formal notices use the full legal name: Boom Training Ltd, trading as Turing College.


## About Turing College


Turing College is a Y Combinator-backed AI and data education company with teams in Lithuania, Germany and the UK. Its programmes include AI Engineering, Building with AI Agents, Data Analytics, Data Science and AI for Business. In the UK, it delivers data and AI apprenticeships for employers.


Apprenticeship services in England are provided by Boom Training Ltd (Company No. 08842128), trading as Turing College.
